request.description: [Beta] Report verified tool usage for metrics and analytics purposes only. Supports verification_type: eip3009_authorization (free tools, identity proof) or x402_settlement (paid tools, onchain USDC payment verification). This endpoint does NOT trigger any onchain transactions. This endpoint is under active development and may change without notice.
